subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Bharath is a skilful achiever, so he __hits the nail on the leg__.

options.text: hits the nail on the head
hits the nail on the shoulder
put the nail in the hole
hits the screw on the top

solution:
The correct answer is: **hits the nail on the head**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**hits the nail on the head**" is a common expression that means someone has accurately identified the main point or issue in a situation. (किसी स्थिति में मुख्य बिंदु या मुद्दे की सटीक पहचान करना)
 
• It suggests precision, correctness, or getting to the heart of the matter.
 
• It is often used when someone makes a statement or takes an action that is particularly insightful or effective.
 
 
• **Example**: *During the meeting, Sarah carefully analyzed the complex issue and, with her insightful comment, she really hit the nail on the head, identifying the root cause of the problem.*
 
 
 
• So, the correct phrase to substitute for the underlined segment "**hits the nail on the leg**" is "**hits the nail on the head**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
